description: Skills whose references/ or assets/ docs still raise render findings, keyed by their path under .skilled/skills. Each entry records the finding count and the render finding types the skill was listed with. The check fails the skill if any count grows or a type appears that the entry does not record. Remove an entry when the skill renders clean; never raise one, and never add an entry to excuse a new finding. The exempt map is separate: it lists docs whose exact text code depends on, each with its consumer: the code file that reads or generates it, or, when a generator takes the path from a contract, that contract file. The packager's render check skips them, and the validator reports their findings as warnings labelled with that consumer. An exempt entry whose consumer file is gone exempts nothing. The pinned list is separate again: it names docs whose exact strings a code check pins, each with that check, and render checks still run on them while the doc rewrite guard refuses to change them. shared/scripts/render_exempt.py is the one reader for both, and an entry whose consumer does not name its doc counts for nothing.
